name: Hello Lady! -New Division-
source:
This is the fandisc for Hello Lady!, bundled with the visual fan book. It adds if stories for popular subheroines Mori and Mitori.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/december-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Hello Lady！》的粉丝碟，与视觉粉丝书捆绑发售。收录人气女配森与美鸟的IF故事。

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/12/18/december-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
